title: 12 South Gilmore Getaway
description:
A stones throw away from 12th, the location of this guesthouse is unbeatable with countless restaurants, bars, and shops just a block over. The entire guesthouse is yours with a private entrance and parking pad. It's the perfect choice for couples, families, or small groups looking for a comfortable and convenient stay in one of Nashville's most sought after neighborhoods. You'll find high end mattresses, luxurious linens, relaxing living area and a full kitchen. We look forward to hosting you!

The space
Please note this is a unit above a garage that our family accesses during normal hours. We are very mindful of our guests and do our best to keep usage considerate and minimal. Also please note it is on the second floor, so there is a flight of stairs to climb.

Other things to note
The parking pad is for one vehicle, but there is plenty of street parking around us that is free and a short walk from the guesthouse.
